name: Concrete boat launch ramp
in_game: The club's ramp and the lake's public ramps (OSM slipways), placed from the map by rule (Track I)
real: One or more 15 ft lanes of grooved concrete at about 14 percent, a flat apron to the parking lot, gravel or riprap shoulders, the toe well under the lowest water. Tyre tracks dark above the water, a dark green slick below it, the silt band and scum line on the sides.

slab_t.source: typical lakefront construction in North Texas; to confirm against Bean's grey-card photos

bottom_below_pool.source: the toe at least 0.5 m under the October 2026 gauge (-0.98 m)

layers: edge_layer.py: wet line, stain band, scum line, algae, run-off, wrack (cards/layers.json)
